intents.text: Add enum `DagSchedulingState` in `airflow.utils.state` with exactly the string values `active`, `draining`, `paused`.

Add non-null boolean `DagModel.is_draining` (default false, indexed, check constraint `NOT (is_paused AND is_draining)`), read-only `scheduling_state` property and `set_scheduling_state(state)` setting both flags consistently, with a 3.4.0 Alembic migration (also adding index on `backfill (dag_id, completed_at)`) and the migrations reference updated.

While a Dag is draining, exclude it from Dags needing scheduled runs, record asset events without queuing the Dag (direct, alias, name/URI), and create no run for its pending partitioned-asset events.

For a draining Dag, keep scheduling/queuing task instances of queued and running runs and examining unfinished runs as for an active Dag; explicit triggers (manual, operator, asset materialisation, backfill) remain allowed.

Add `SchedulerJobRunner._finalize_draining_dags(session)` run every 5 seconds in the scheduler loop, moving a draining Dag to paused when it has no queued/running run and no accepted-but-uninitialised backfill (backfill row without Dag runs), writing a `Log` entry with event `drain_completed`, owner `scheduler`, processing in `dag_id` order with per-query limit and row locks.
Automatic pausing after the configured consecutive failed runs pauses the Dag and clears draining.

Add `scheduling_state` (default `active`) to `DAGResponse` and `DAGDetailsResponse`; `PATCH /dags/{dag_id}` and `PATCH /dags` require exactly one non-null of `is_paused`/`scheduling_state` (else 422, explicit null for the unused field accepted), `update_mask` may name one of them and a mismatch with the body is 422, responses reflect the new state, bulk PATCH sets both flags, and `is_paused` clients behave as before (clearing draining).

In `/ui/dags` add a `scheduling_state` filter (existing `paused` filter unchanged, `paused=false` includes draining), add `has_unfinished_runs` to every listed Dag independent of `dag_runs_limit`, and exclude draining Dags from dashboard `active_dag_count`.
`airflow dags pause`/`unpause` set paused/active and clear draining (a draining Dag counts as needing change), and `dags details` includes `scheduling_state`.
Document draining in the Dag concepts page and FAQ and add a newsfragment announcing it.
Add or extend unit tests for the model, scheduler, asset manager, public and UI REST routes and CLI, keeping existing suites green.

constraints: Do not touch the React UI under airflow-core/src/airflow/ui
`is_paused` keeps its meaning everywhere and existing clients that only know `is_paused` must keep working unchanged
Pause and unpause remain available from API and CLI
A Dag is never both paused and draining
Draining is transient and always converges to paused
